item.tib: dbal chen ge khod kyi srung ba gsal byed rgyud las
item.coloph: nyi ri shel bzhin (mkhan chen nyi ma) da du phyung ba srung gur bsgom kur bsgom pa dang bsnyen bzlas ting 'dzin ces bdud 'dul ge khod kyi srung ba'i gur khang bsgom lugs nyung thus dang / bsrung sngags bcas bdud 'dul gsang ba'i rtsa rgyud las gud du phyung ba 'di yang / sgo btsun nyi ri shel bzhin gyis sman ri bla brang du bsgrigs pa dge bar gyur cig/
